title.zh: COVID-19（临时措施）（回教法庭停止适用第 28 条）命令 2022
title.en: COVID-19 (Temporary Measures) (Cessation of Section 28 for Syariah Court) Order 2022

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the COVID‑19 (Temporary Measures) (Cessation of Section 28 for Syariah Court) Order 2022 and is deemed to have come into operation on 30 November 2022.

heading.en: Cessation of section 28 of Act for Syariah Court

text.en: 2. The Minister declares that section 28 of the Act ceases to apply in relation to any action or proceedings in the Syariah Court, whether commenced before, on or after 30 November 2022 and in respect of which no order under section 28(3) of the Act has been made before 30 November 2022.

3. Despite paragraph 2, section 28 of the Act continues to apply to or in relation to —
(a)any action or proceedings in respect of which an order under section 28(3) of the Act was made before 30 November 2022;
(b)any evidence given by a witness in any action or proceedings in the Syariah Court, by means of a live video or live television link that is created using a remote communication technology approved by the senior president of the Syariah Court, pursuant to an order under section 28(3) of the Act made before 30 November 2022; and
(c)any appearance made (other than to give evidence) by a witness in any action or proceedings in the Syariah Court, by means of a live video, live television link or live audio link that is created using a remote communication technology approved by the senior president of the Syariah Court, pursuant to an order under section 28(3) of the Act made before 30 November 2022.
